channel.title: Wild Cards
channel.desc: Max finds herself playing hostage negotiator when a kidnapped woman calls 911 using a makeshift phone, unraveling a complex web involving an affair, gambling and a race against time at a NASCAR event. Actors: Vanessa Morgan, Giacomo Gianniotti, Tamara Taylor, Justin Allgaier, Terry Chen, Michael Xavier, Amy Goodmurphy, Fletcher Donovan.
